target_app: Class Calendar Planner - Teacher Homework Organizer
purpose: Transform raw homework copy-paste text into parser-compatible import text for non-debate and debate template imports.

global_rules.line_endings: Use LF or CRLF. App normalizes line endings.
global_rules.trim_behavior: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed by parser.
global_rules.blank_line_rule: Use one empty line between non-debate blocks for reliable splitting.
global_rules.no_preamble_text: Do not include text before the first recognized heading/day marker.

non_debate.section_rule: A line matching a recognized heading starts a new book section.
non_debate.entry_rule: Within each book section, each blank-line-separated block becomes one template entry.
non_debate.organization_rule: Use unit-part naming for non-debate blocks (Unit N Part 1 / Unit N Part 2).
non_debate.title_rule: Entry title becomes first line of block (up to 70 chars).
non_debate.example:
IPE
Unit 1 Part 1
Covered in class: ...
Homework: ...

Unit 1 Part 2
Covered in class: ...
Homework: ...

Subject Link
Unit 3 Part 1
Covered in class: ...
Homework: ...

debate.section_rule: Each recognized day marker starts a new debate block.
debate.entry_rule: All lines after a marker belong to that day until the next marker.
debate.example:
Day 1
Covered in class: ...
Homework: ...

Day 2
Covered in class: ...
Homework: ...

Day 4 / Preview
Covered in class: ...
Homework: ...

llm_transformation_contract.objective: Rewrite messy source text into parser-compatible import text without changing educational meaning.
must_enforce: Exact recognized headings for non-debate book sections
Exact recognized day markers for debate sections
must_not: Add preface text before first heading/day marker
llm_transformation_contract.output_mode: Return plain text only, no markdown fences, no commentary.

validation_checklist: Starts immediately with a valid heading/day marker
Each non-debate book section has at least one content block
Each debate day marker used has non-empty content
No accidental duplicate day headers unless intentionally separate blocks
